recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It fixes the remaining stale Bundle wording for the applied STU3 issue while leaving the separate unresolved Bundle.issues deprecation question to FHIR-50491 or future work-group action.
issue_request: FHIR-17064 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Feed change request from the 2018-May Core Norm ballot asking the Bundle.entry.search.mode wording to reflect that search.mode has three reasons: match, _include, and information/warning information about the search process.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was already done. No current Git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-17064, but same-family FHIR-17096 was applied in svn 14400 / git c03e0817b9b9dffd6ca6dfea6d19f262e5f8f653, which updated the former Bundle spreadsheet with the requested definition and the short 'match | include | outcome - why this is in the result set'. Later source rework preserved that short before a cleanup commit removed outcome from the current StructureDefinition short.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini, making the edited Bundle StructureDefinition and notes current build inputs. The full Bundle.entry.search.mode definition, binding description, SearchEntryMode CodeSystem, and ValueSet already contained the requested information/warning wording. Adjacent current source still documents OperationOutcome entries with search.mode outcome. Later FHIR-50491 asks whether outcome references should move to Bundle.issues, but it is Triaged/unresolved and was not applied here.
reconciliation: Changed source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml so the Bundle.entry.search.mode short lists match | include | outcome, and changed source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml so the search-set notes no longer describe search.mode as only match/include.
source_changes: source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml: expanded the search.mode narrative to include entries that convey information or warning information about the search process.

related_jiras.note: Parallel Published/Persuasive issue for the SearchEntryMode CodeSystem description; already represented on the combined branch by commit 1da201bc1d553f3864761998b969289e912d1166.
Later Triaged/unresolved R6 issue asking whether search.mode=outcome mentions should be replaced by Bundle.issues; it does not supersede this applied STU3 correction.
